patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient presents with a 3-day history of pain in his left wrist, which worsened this morning accompanied by chills and malaise. He recounts having a self-resolving left knee pain the previous week. Reports recent return from a camping trip in Minnesota. Sexually active with one female partner. No history of trauma to the wrist.

Secondary_Symptoms: Painless violaceous vesiculopustular lesions on both wrists and hands
Swelling and erythema of the left wrist
Severe tenderness to palpation and passive movement of the left wrist

patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: Otherwise healthy with no significant past medical history.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Admits to being sexually active with one female partner who uses a diaphragm for contraception. Recently went on a camping trip to Minnesota.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: Denies trauma to the wrist, reports a history of knee pain that resolved on its own. No other systemic symptoms mentioned.

objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the young patient presenting with wrist pain, fever, and skin lesions.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Hi doctor—my left wrist has been hurting for about three days, and it got much worse this morning. I’ve also had chills and just feel really run-down, and I noticed painless purple, blister-like bumps on both wrists and hands.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any areas of your skin that look scratched, rubbed raw, or have small open spots (excoriations)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any areas that look scratched or rubbed raw, and I don’t recall any small open spots or excoriations—just those painless purple blister-like bumps on my wrists and hands.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any episodes where you stop breathing or you suddenly wake up gasping for air during sleep? (yes/no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t had any episodes where I stop breathing or wake up gasping for air during sleep.”

turns.doctor_question: After your minor injury, have you noticed any signs that a bone might be broken—such as severe pain, obvious swelling or deformity, inability to use the area, or pain that’s getting worse instead of better? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No—I didn’t have any injury or trauma, but my left wrist is very swollen and red, and it hurts a lot even with gentle movement. It’s definitely getting worse, and I can’t really use it normally because of the severe tenderness.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any redness or warmth on your **left wrist** (compared with the other side)?
turns.patient_answer: “Yes, doctor—the left wrist is clearly more red and warm than the other side, with noticeable swelling and severe tenderness when I try to move it or when you move it gently.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bruising on your chest wall (for example, from a bump, fall, or even without remembering an injury)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed any bruising on my chest wall, and I don’t recall any bump or fall that could’ve caused bruising.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been urinating much more than usual lately—like needing to go to the bathroom more often or producing a larger amount of urine?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed myself urinating more often or producing more urine than usual.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you ever used any substances such as alcohol, tobacco, cannabis, opioids (like prescription pain pills or heroin), stimulants (like cocaine or meth), or other recreational drugs?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I don’t use any tobacco, alcohol, cannabis, opioids, stimulants, or other recreational drugs.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any trouble controlling your urine—such as leaking or accidentally passing urine—recently?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t had any trouble controlling my urine. I haven’t noticed any leaking or accidents, and my urination seems normal besides not feeling especially well from the chills and malaise.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any nosebleeds recently (even if they were mild or only a few drops)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t had any nosebleeds recently, even minor ones.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have a rash on your trunk (chest, back, or belly)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed any rash on my trunk, like on my chest, back, or belly.”
